g.text: One receivables-backed facility. Follow the cash, then follow the lender’s position.
Borrowed tUSD goes directly to the operator / servicer
* Before expiry: redeem matching PT + YT. After expiry: redeem PT. Both routes return pCREDIT via SY; cash needs vault liquidity.
QuoteMarket transfers seller tokens directly to the buyer and buyer tUSD directly to the seller. It does not guarantee a buyer.
Synthetic invoices + valueless tUSD. One fixed portfolio. Real contract execution. Legal rights, independent verification and production credit operations remain outside this demo.
Green: cash Blue: token ownership Dashed purple: signed claims Dashed grey: valuation data
